## Summary

Two related additions from a design brainstorm:

1. **Spec — `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-08-filter-events-design.md`** (779 lines)
   New event family (`FilterCreate`, `FilterDelete`, `FilterSet`, `FilterRefAdded`, `FilterRefRemoved`) that runs during transaction processing as pure functions returning **pass / reject / amend**, plus `add_commands(closure)` for queueing companion commands.

   - Reuses existing cross-object qualifier grammar (`class()`, `ref()`, `referrers()`, `children()`) and the shipped `PrecommitStore` overlay — no new qualifier syntax.
   - Outside-in chain composition: cross-object filters first, inline same-class filter has the final word (protects class invariants).
   - Cycle detection via visited-set for routing-key amendments (`Class` in `FilterCreate`, destination in `FilterRefAdded`).
   - Source/destination asymmetry for ref operations: `FilterSet` on source amends value, `FilterRefAdded` on destination can redirect, `FilterRefRemoved` is veto-only.
   - Round-based execution for companion commands with per-invocation, per-round, and max-rounds caps.
   - Visibility = existing `Precommit` rules; `tx.done`/`tx.pending`/`tx.added` lazy three-list; `actor` from operation token.
   - `ValidateValue` / `ParseValue` retained alongside (different scope, different question).
   - Depends on `2026-05-06-rhai-hardening-design.md` shipping first.
   - Motivation: fills the documented gap in `binding.md` (no compatibility veto today). Architecturally validated by expressing layered authorization with no knowledge in observed classes.

2. **`.claude/hooks/session-start.sh` + `.claude/settings.json`**
   Auto-installs the `obra/superpowers` plugin in every Claude Code on the web session for this repo. Idempotent; runs only when `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true`. `.gitignore` updated to track `.claude/hooks/` and `.claude/settings.json` for everyone.

   Also un-ignores `docs/superpowers/specs/` (matches the existing pattern — 26 specs are already tracked there; the rule blocked only new ones).

Spec self-reviewed three passes per the staged-design-review skill (P7 + P8). Final verdict: 0 substantive issues remaining.

## Test plan

- [ ] Spec reviewed by maintainer; substantive design feedback incorporated before implementation
- [ ] Confirm Rhai-hardening (`2026-05-06`) lands before any implementation phase begins
- [ ] On a fresh cloud session against this branch, verify SessionStart hook installs Superpowers cleanly (already validated locally)
- [ ] No code changes — no test suite to run
